Hi Soojin,

We're approaching our renewal window and AtlasData is planning to expand usage materially for H2. Our platform team is requesting a formal proposal for:
- Premium SLA (4hr P1 response; 99.9% availability objective for inference endpoints)
- Latency SLOs: 95th pct < 120ms for short-text generation workloads, 50ms P50 target
- Dedicated capacity reservation for predictable throughput (estimate: reserved 8 GPUs, burst to 12)

Two asks from procurement: a redlined term sheet they can review and an itemized cost delta for the premium support add-on plus any burst fees. Chris (CC) is fine with a technical call if Ben can join for sizing.

Can you put a draft together this week? We'll need procurement looped by Friday if possible.

Thanks,
Nora

Nora / Soojin — joined the call notes and initial sizing below.

Summary from perf quick check (internal testbed aligned to Atlas sample workload):
- P50 latency: 28–45ms for short-text (seq len ~64) on gpus with reduced attention kernel + int8 quantization
- P95: 80–140ms depending on cold-warm cache ratio. With KV prefetching + continuous batching tuned to your QPS distribution, we reliably hit P95 < 120ms on a dedicated 8-GPU pool for your baseline load.

Burst plan: reserve 8 GPUs (steady), with burst to 12 (auto-burst). We recommend a warm-up window (prefill KV cache) and a short billing window for burst (15 min buckets) to balance cost and SLO. Included worksheet: Burst_Planning_worksheet.xlsx (estimate sheet).

Security / Private deployment note: If Atlas wants VPC/private deployment, we can still offer the premium SLA but need KMS integration (customer key) and SOC 2 evidence exchange — will add a separate schedule for Private.

I'll update the term sheet with the quantization/ops recommendations and a recommended autoscale policy.

- Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Procurement / Nora — thanks for the redlines, received and reviewed. Quick responses to each point below and next steps.

1) Payment terms: Net45 is fine for this renewal — Connor will update the term sheet language and confirm with Finance.
2) Credits cap: We can accept a 3% annual spend cap on credits for the agreed premium SLA; added to SLA_Addendum_v2.
